summary: The <thead> section. Takes no props — it places the header row and gives its cells their head-or-body context.
useWhen: every Table with column headers, which is every data table

composition.note: Exists so TableRow and TableCell can tell head from body through context, rather than the caller repeating a prop that has to stay in sync with where the row actually sits.

guarantees: cells inside it default to <th scope="col">, and a row-selection cell becomes the select-all header
requires: a header row for every data table — without one, no data cell has a column to be associated with

antiPatterns.dont: a data table with no TableHead
antiPatterns.why: a screen-reader user hears values with no field names

antiPatterns.dont: styling a first TableBody row to look like a header
antiPatterns.why: it looks like a header and announces as data
